items.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022
items.q: I remember doing a project with Dr. Billy Taylor and the Turtle Island String Quartet

ctx.x: I assume that you’ve taken a razor blade to tape a number of times?

I have. I remember doing a project with Dr. Billy Taylor and the Turtle Island String Quartet and it was 24-track analog, one of the last projects I guess I did on 24-track analog. And he was doing some sort of I guess best could be called a cadenza and it came down and there was this downbeat and then we were going to cut to something else. And you know sometimes when you rock tape you can hear what you need to do rather easily. And there was one thing, I don’t know, and I even — the tape was rolling and just at…

I remember the first time I saw it happen I was astounded actually. And then to learn that it happens in classical performances also, I guess I didn’t envision that it would even be used in the classical world.
